parameters.query:
SELECT url, tree, id_map, next_id
FROM tmp_tab_state
WHERE tab_id = $1

-- $1 tab_id, $2 url, $3 tree, $4 id_map, $5 next_id, $6 website, $7 title, $8 events
WITH state AS (
  INSERT INTO tmp_tab_state (tab_id, url, tree, id_map, next_id, updated_at)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4::jsonb, $5::int, now())
  ON CONFLICT (tab_id) DO UPDATE
    SET url = EXCLUDED.url, tree = EXCLUDED.tree, id_map = EXCLUDED.id_map,
        next_id = EXCLUDED.next_id, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING tab_id
),
evs AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($8::jsonb) AS e("at" timestamptz, "kind" text, "text" text)
),
existing AS (
  SELECT activity_id FROM tmp_activities
  WHERE tab_id = $1 AND website = $6 AND status = 'open'
    AND last_event_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'
    AND started_at > now() - interval '60 minutes'
  ORDER BY last_event_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
created AS (
  INSERT INTO tmp_activities (activity_id, tab_id, website, page_title)
  SELECT gen_random_uuid()::text, $1, $6, $7
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM evs)
  RETURNING activity_id
),
target AS (
  SELECT activity_id FROM existing WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM evs)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT activity_id FROM created
),
touched AS (
  UPDATE tmp_activities SET last_event_at = now(), page_title = $7
  WHERE activity_id IN (SELECT activity_id FROM existing) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM evs)
  RETURNING activity_id
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO tmp_activity_events (activity_id, at, kind, text)
  SELECT t.activity_id, e.at, e.kind, e.text FROM target t CROSS JOIN evs e
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT activity_id FROM target LIMIT 1) AS activity_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted) AS events_inserted
